content.short: Stargate is a DeFi-focused liquidity bridge.
content.description: Stargate presents a distinctive DeFi bridge with a clean, intuitive interface, enabling cross-ecosystem swaps between native tokens from different chains. The protocol supports swapping native tokens across diverse blockchain ecosystems, allowing users to move value between networks. Users can also contribute assets to Stargate's liquidity pool and earn real-time stablecoins as rewards. The STG token provides utilities such as staking and farming, offering additional ways to participate in the Stargate ecosystem.
